lines.zh: 我浮在离地半尺的地方。
lines.en: I float half a block above the ground.

lines.zh: 水母似的身子一涨一缩。
lines.en: My jellyfish body swells and shrinks.
My tendrils trail beneath me.

lines.zh: 我飘过河面，没有落下去。
lines.en: I drift over the river without landing.
Sparks jump across my body.

lines.zh: 我离开锚点，又飘回半圈。
lines.en: I leave my anchor and drift half a circle back.
I rise a little.
I drift to the bank and back.
I pass a clump of weed.
I stop above the water's surface.
I turn to you and my tendrils sway.

lines.zh: 触手一摆，我又飘了开去。
lines.en: My tendrils sway and I drift off.

lines.zh: 我悬着，身上有电流过的声音。
lines.en: I hover, current humming through me.

lines.zh: 悬着的时候，我没有重量。
lines.en: Hovering, I have no weight.
Light passes beneath me.
My tendrils sway gently.
It's pleasant here.

lines.zh: 我在这里待着，慢慢转着。
lines.en: I stay here, turning slowly.
Reflections play on me.
I wait for my master's word.

lines.zh: 没有人叫我的时候，我就在附近飘。
lines.en: When no one calls, I drift nearby.
I flash once.
The river is quiet here.
I bob up and down on the water.

lines.zh: 电在我身体里绕了一圈。
lines.en: Current loops through my body.
I have no feet, and I don't tire.
All my tentacles turn toward you.
I'm a Champion level.
You look interesting.
I bring my face up to yours.
You could touch me. It tingles.

lines.zh: 摸我一下会发麻，你就缩手了。
lines.en: Touch me and it tingles. You pulled back.
You pulled back. I laugh.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的耳边飘过去。
lines.en: I drift past your ear.
I'm watching your expression.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的神色，你半点没躲。
lines.en: I watch your face. You don't flinch.
I settle beside you.

lines.zh: 我飘回你身侧，该动身了。
lines.en: I drift back to your side. Let's go.
Let's go. You lead.
You lead. I can keep up.
Don't worry. I drift fast.
I'm quick. Don't worry.
My body flickers.
I drift unsteadily.
Half my tendrils retract.

lines.zh: 我想说点什么，我不出声。
lines.en: I want to say something. I stay quiet.
Current jumps wildly over me.

lines.zh: 那一击穿透了我，我倒退半尺。
lines.en: That went through me. I retreat half a block.
There's a hole in me; my charge leaks out.
The scattered charge returns to my body.
I can still float.
When my master asks, I'll tell it straight.
That in your hand. Is it seafood?
I drift close and sniff.
This tang of the sea — I'll taste it first.

lines.zh: 这股味儿对我胃口，我不推辞。
lines.en: That smell suits me. No ceremony.
No politeness. Gone in one bite.
Gone already. More?
I could eat more.
One inch closer and your fingertips go numb.

lines.zh: 手别凑这么近，会挨一下电。
lines.en: Don't reach that close. You'll get a shock.
After this, I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 吃完我随你走，别处都不去。
lines.en: After this I follow you. Nowhere else.
Nowhere else. Just follow.
You bump me and get a shock.
I pull back, tendrils flaring.

lines.zh: 电荷太满，它自己跳出来。
lines.en: My charge overflowed and leapt out on its own.
The current in me doesn't always obey.

lines.zh: 身上的电不肯安分，你退开了。
lines.en: The current won't settle. You step back.
You stepped back. Your hand went numb?

lines.zh: 我往水面那边退开一尺。
lines.en: I back a foot toward the water's surface.
Your hand must be numb. I'll wait.
I'm not your enemy.

lines.zh: 我不是来打架的，放松一点。
lines.en: I'm not your enemy. Ease up.
Digimon don't do that.
We grow by evolving.
I'm Champion level now.
Beyond that is Thetismon.
There's more evolution ahead of me.
I float up and turn a circle.
I'm not there yet. Give it time.
Just wait. I'll get stronger.
Then I'll show you.

lines.zh: 等我变了给你瞧，这话算数。
lines.en: I'll show you when I change. That's a promise.
I curl a tendril around it.

lines.zh: 触手一卷，分量比看着重。
lines.en: One tendril curls around it. Heavier than it looks.
It's heavy. I wobble in the air.

lines.zh: 我用触手把它摆在沙上。
lines.en: I lay it on the sand with my tentacles.
What I hold is still struggling.
I let go; it runs off.

lines.zh: 一松手它就窜了，随它去。
lines.en: I let go and it bolts. Never mind.

lines.zh: 这东西太沉，我松了触手。
lines.en: Too heavy; I let go with my tentacles.
Would my master want this?

lines.zh: 主人也许会要，我先留着。
lines.en: My master might want it. I'll keep it.
Something's over by the water.

lines.zh: 水里传来动静，我扭身去看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the water. I turn to look.
The current starts to gather.

lines.zh: 电流聚起来，我抬起触手。
lines.en: The current gathers. I raise my tendrils.

lines.zh: 抬起来一看，这不是主人。
lines.en: Raised, I see it isn't my master.
Then I can't let it pass.

lines.zh: 那就饶不得它，我升到半空。
lines.en: Then it can't be spared. I rise.
So I face it from above.

lines.zh: 我从上方压下去，把它咬住。
lines.en: I come from above and lock on.
In midair, I've got the drop point.

lines.zh: 我算好了距离，我亮起来。
lines.en: Range measured. I light up.
I flare. The thunder is coming.
Don't stand too close. It runs for the water.
I drift after it.
I can discharge in water too.

lines.zh: 在水里照样放电，水会导电。
lines.en: I can discharge in water. It conducts.
Water conducts, and it noticed.
It changes direction. I rise higher.

lines.zh: 我又升一层，自高处取它。
lines.en: I climb a layer and take it from above.
It raises something to block.
It comes from above.
It looks up. Too late.
Too late. I come down.

lines.zh: 我俯冲而下，电光将它吞没。
lines.en: I drop, and the current swallows it.
Up close, I lash my tendrils.
Current runs down the tendrils.
Time. Thunderbolt!
The light floods the river.
It's shocked stiff.

lines.zh: 它被电得直哆嗦，我稍微退开。
lines.en: It shudders. I draw back a little.
That felt good.

lines.zh: 这一击够痛快，接着再来。
lines.en: That felt good. Again.
My master said not to overuse it.
I'll hold back. I drift back.
Back in place, and it's still moving.

lines.zh: 它没倒下，我也还站得住。
lines.en: It's still up, and so am I.
The river's surface parts and I rise.
Water still clings to me.
Current jumps between the droplets.
I lift above the water.

lines.zh: 我浮到水面之上，附近有条河。
lines.en: I rise above the surface. There's a river here.
First, I note the anchor point.
A river here, and the water is bright.
I see someone on the bank.
I drift half a block toward the bank.
The mist clears before I show myself.

lines.zh: 我在几步外停住，等对方先说话。
lines.en: I stop a few paces off and let them speak.
I can stay around here.

lines.zh: 火碰到水汽，只烫到我一点。
lines.en: Fire hits my vapor and only stings.

lines.zh: 我不会摔伤，但也摔得很难看。
lines.en: Falling can't hurt me, but it looked bad.

lines.zh: 我在水里，可水流太急，我转不出去。
lines.en: In water, but the current spins me too fast.

lines.zh: 一阵气浪把我掀得转了个向。
lines.en: The blast spins me sideways.

lines.zh: 弹丸从我身体里穿过去。
lines.en: A round passes through my body.
Light suppresses my current.
No food, and my current weakens.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，反而被我吸了一点。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and some of it is absorbed.
The void stretches me thin.
